snippet.title: OUTDATED (do still buy if you see this) Steam Trailer VR - Wishlist Now!
snippet.description: The Council of Six is coming and they're going to reboot earth?!  The Galactic Federation has now experienced a giant influx of tourists that want to see earth before it's gone. They’ve got you working as a cryopod-handler, fondling aliens and helping them recover from their journey. All-in-all a pretty standard job, except you can’t leave your booth because you’re also required to eat, sleep, and relieve yourself there. Federation policy.
